Please, find below a post-doc offer in computational medicine [please, contact directly the contact for this offer ... I'm just forwarding it]

🚨 We're hiring a Postdoctoral Scholar at Stanford Medicine!

If you're excited about the future of AI, clinical trials, and digital twins, we'd love to hear from you.

Our lab is building the next generation of AI methods to transform how we design and evaluate clinical trials, from modeling patient trajectories and creating digital twins to developing synthetic control arms, improving patient recruitment, and supporting clinical decision making. This is an opportunity to work with rich multimodal clinical data, collaborate across Stanford Medicine, and help answer some of the biggest questions in healthcare AI:

🧬 How can digital twins personalize treatment and predict outcomes? 📊 How can AI make clinical trials faster, more efficient, and more inclusive? 🏥 How do we build trustworthy AI that works in real clinical settings?

We are looking for someone who has:
✔️ A strong publication record in machine learning, AI, biomedical informatics, or a related field ✔️ The ability to work independently and lead ambitious research projects ✔️ A strong work ethic and a desire to translate methodological innovation into real clinical impact

A postdoctoral appointment is ONLY for recent PhD graduates. If you are passionate about rigorous science and want to tackle important problems with real world impact, I'd love to hear from you. Please send your CV, research statement, cover letter, two representative publications, and three references
